verdict.rationale: Evidence shows CLI install instructions (e.g., brew install azure-cli) and general docs links, but no concrete quickstart tutorial with exact end-to-end commands taking a developer from zero to a running service within an hour. Community feedback (azure-comm-20) even describes onboarding as 'insane how complicated', undercutting a smooth first-deploy claim. missing for 10: a specific quickstart doc with full command sequence, evidence of time-to-deploy, and independent confirmation of a fast first deployment experience.
